case: Changed-goal cases have positive probability .5; at least 25% of excluded changed-goal documents remain uncertain under the final-text reader at each setting.
construction: Makers are nested within worlds. Reader comparisons share observations within a setting. Different setting cells use independent worlds; no paired causal claim. All unavailable outputs remain explicit.
controls: Inherited exact-law known answers plus Friday-specific alias, persistence, source and setting checks. Controls never impose a desired science effect.
interpretation: Exploratory constructed-method lower-rate boundary map; miniature, architecture untested; no confirmation or human inference.
precision: 256 independent worlds per cell; maximum binomial Monte Carlo standard error 0.0312; log-score uncertainty estimated across worlds. The whole-world count is doubled before new data because the target event rate is halved from 0.05 to 0.025.
probe_rule: One excluded world at every declared setting; complete original, replay and scalar reconstruction. Per-pass cost uses the largest observed whole-world time with 50% margin, plus overhead.
question: With revision rate 0.025, how does the cell-to-cell sign variation seen at 0.05 behave at the complete and mostly incomplete revision endpoints across discovery timing and document length?
registration_reason: The completed 0.05 revision map crosses zero across independent cells. A full doubled 12-cell map would press against the remaining H3 family ceiling, so this card prospectively retains the natural completeness endpoints, both discovery times and both document lengths at 0.025. It selects no cell by observed sign and is not confirmation or a paired contrast.
